name: stack-item
description: A single row primitive used by list-like containers such as list-view and tree-view.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: The row: background that fills when the item is selected or highlighted. It carries the shared row chrome of list-view and tree-view.

anatomy.name: checkbox
anatomy.description: Selection checkbox shown in a selection mode.

anatomy.name: thumbnail
anatomy.description: Thumbnail at the start of the content, used instead of the icon.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Text of the item; the relationships set its minimum width.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Row of action buttons at the end of the item.

anatomy.name: drill-in-chevron
anatomy.description: Non-interactive chevron that shows the item navigates to another level.

anatomy.name: focus-indicator
anatomy.description: Outline drawn around the focused row.

anatomyReview.notes: Decision A68 D5a: stack-item stays the shared row-chrome component (Slack #spectrum-tokens-talk Jan 2026: Design made list-view and tree-view use the stack-item tokens); it takes list-item's anatomy. list-view and tree-view keep their own records; a follow-up proposal covers nesting and sharing. Figma S2 Web List view item (Drag handle, Content: visual + text + actions, Navigation indicator). Renames: header -> label (the sources say label; two records follow), visual -> icon and thumbnail, disclosure-indicator -> drill-in-chevron (decision A71 D8 a2). description added from list-item.
